Adapted port: ATLAS added the Meta header and an attribution notice (original formalization by Zeina Migeed, ported with permission); replaced the explicit-tau value variable with an ambient HasTau instance variable, the fork WeakStep/WeaklyBisimilar forms with STr/HomWeakBisimilarity, and the weakStep_of_ne/silentClosure conversions with direct STr reasoning plus private match helpers; dropped the now-unused WeakCslibBridge import; renamed the WeaklyBisimilar.* theorems to HomWeakBisimilarity.*. The code is otherwise identical to formal-math at the pin.

Adapted port: ATLAS added the Meta header and renamed Cslib.Semantics.LTS.OmegaRun to Cslib.LTS.OmegaRun and Semantics.LTS.reachable_omegaRun_apply to Cslib.LTS.canReach_omegaRun_apply; the module docstring additionally documents the run-level API design and the OmegaWordBridge conversion to the canonical word semantics; the code is otherwise identical to formal-math at the pin. Also: the reachable_of_forallRuns_always_atom docstring states its hypotheses and conclusion in words and why the run-coverage hypothesis is needed (no infinite run starts at a deadlocked state).

ATLAS-side docstring edit not in formal-math: the satisfiesAt_always and satisfiesAt_eventually docstrings say at or after position k (k + j for every or some j, including j = 0) instead of every or some later position.

Restate docstrings to match the Lean statements (Atlas wiki audit, #989). Also: Imports the CSLib v4.35.0 propositional logic restored under CSLibExt/Logics/Propositional/Legacy (removed upstream in CSLib #1200) for the v4.36.0 toolchain bump; formal-math needs the same change when it moves to v4.36.0. For the v4.36.0 toolchain bump, it now refers to the declarations formerly in the namespace `Cslib.Logic.PL` by their names in `Cslib.Logic.LegacyPL`, because CSLib v4.36.0 declares its new `Proposition` as `Cslib.Logic.PL.Proposition`; formal-math needs the same renaming when it moves to v4.36.0. Its prose now attributes the propositional logic it works with to CSLib v4.35, as restored in `Cslib.Logic.LegacyPL`, instead of to current CSLib.
